mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_custom_plate_member WHERE custom_plate_id = #{customPlateId} AND active = 1

SELECT member.stock_code, basic.stock_name FROM stock_custom_plate_member member LEFT JOIN stock_basic basic ON basic.stock_code = member.stock_code AND basic.last_seen_trade_date = (SELECT MAX(last_seen_trade_date) FROM stock_basic) WHERE member.custom_plate_id = #{customPlateId} AND member.active = 1 ORDER BY member.stock_code LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_custom_plate_member SET active = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE custom_plate_id = #{customPlateId} AND active = 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO stock_custom_plate_member (custom_plate_id, stock_code, active) VALUES
(#{item.customPlateId}, #{item.stockCode}, 1)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT plate.category_code, plate.id AS custom_plate_id, plate.plate_name, member.stock_code FROM stock_custom_plate plate INNER JOIN stock_custom_plate_member member ON member.custom_plate_id = plate.id WHERE plate.active = 1 AND member.active = 1 ORDER BY plate.id, member.stock_code
